_comment: lvlInstance's trivial virtuals - the base cases of the per-instance dispatch that runs for
every object in the city each frame. Each is one instruction in the binary.
GetVelocity (0x004643A0) and GetRadius (0x004643E0) are deliberately NOT here: they return a
static Vector3 at 0x006A3B08 and index a 0x20-stride table at 0x006316D0, and porting them
before those globals are symbolised would bake a hard-coded address into C++.
